workspace.title: Account security
workspace.description: Protect your personal Pressly identity and review the session you are using now.

recoveryCodes.title: Save your recovery codes now
recoveryCodes.description: Each code works once if your authenticator is unavailable. Pressly will not display these codes again.
recoveryCodes.credentialsDescription: Store these in a password manager. Do not send them in email or team chat.

mfaSetup.title: Set up multi-factor authentication
mfaSetup.description: Use a personal authenticator app. Pressly never asks an employee to share their security codes.
mfaSetup.readyDescription: Pressly will show a private setup key. Add it to your authenticator, then enter the six-digit code it generates.
mfaSetup.keyDescription: This key remains only in this setup view. It is not saved in browser storage.

mfa.title: Multi-factor authentication
mfa.description: An authenticator code protects manager and owner actions even if a password is exposed.
mfa.pausedDescription: Set up MFA to invite employees or change business access. Read-only review remains available.
mfa.verified: Your current session is MFA verified.

session.title: Current session
session.description: This browser session is protected by a host-only, HttpOnly cookie. Control never exposes the credential to page scripts.

history.title: Security history
history.description: Important workforce and account changes are recorded without exposing credentials, invitation links, or private payloads.
history.emptyDescription: Invitations, access changes, and session actions will appear here.

confirm.removeDescription: Other active sessions will be revoked and privileged Control actions will pause until MFA is set up again.
confirm.replaceDescription: Every current recovery code will stop working. Pressly will display the replacements once.
